record.paper_title: Some open problems in Banach space theory
record.original_question: Does the space C(ℓ₂) of compact operators on ℓ₂, equipped with the usual operator norm, have the uniform approximation property? Also, does the disc algebra have the uniform approximation property?

evidence.quote:
(Q.8,) Does the space C(l2) ( the space of compact operators on 
l2 with the usual
operator norm) have the UAP ? Does the disc algebra have the UAP ?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\ell_2$ denote the separable Hilbert space, and let $\mathcal{K}(\ell_2)$ denote the Banach space of compact linear operators on $\ell_2$ equipped with the operator norm. Let $A(\mathbb{D})$ denote the disc algebra, that is, the Banach space of continuous functions on the closed unit disc $\overline{\mathbb{D}} \subset \mathbb{C}$ that are holomorphic in the open unit disc, equipped with the supremum norm.

A Banach space $X$ is said to have the uniform approximation property (UAP) if there exists a constant $\lambda \geq 1$ and a function $k : \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}$ such that for every finite-dimensional subspace $E \subset X$ with $\dim E = n$, there exists a finite-rank linear operator $T : X \to X$ satisfying:
(i) $T(x) = x$ for all $x \in E$,
(ii) $\|T\| \leq \lambda$,
(iii) $\operatorname{rank}(T) \leq k(n)$.

Determine whether each of the following Banach spaces has the uniform approximation property:
(a) $\mathcal{K}(\ell_2)$;
(b) the disc algebra $A(\mathbb{D})$.
artifact.status_search_result: Web searches did not surface a definitive resolution of whether the space of compact operators on $\ell_2$ or the disc algebra possess the uniform approximation property. Both spaces are known to have the bounded approximation property (the disc algebra via Bočkarev's basis, 1974), but the stronger UAP question does not appear to be settled in available sources, so the status is recorded as unknown.

status_evidence.title: History, Developments and Open Problems on Approximation Properties
status_evidence.snippet: Survey discusses the uniform approximation property and lists open problems concerning various classical Banach spaces.
status_evidence.claim: UAP for classical spaces like the disc algebra and K(ℓ2) is not listed as resolved in this survey.

status_evidence.title: Approximation property - Wikipedia
status_evidence.snippet: Bočkarev showed in 1974 that the disk algebra A(D) admits a basis... The space of bounded operators on ℓ2 does not have the AP (Szankowski).
status_evidence.claim: The disc algebra has a (Schauder) basis hence BAP, but UAP is a stronger property not addressed.
